candidate_f2p.oracle: Rendered nodes in one bundle use a common hue and distinguishable depth-dependent saturation/lightness.
A non-root leaf exposes separately styled name and size captions while the root All caption is absent.

candidate_p2p.oracle: Existing treemap navigation and selection remain functional.

classification_rule: F2P/P2P labels are assigned only after the identical executable tests run on base and gold; source tokens alone are not a functional oracle.
